payout_value_note: flat $100 Smart Spending Checking new-account bonus
payout_quote: To qualify for the $100 New Smart Spending Checking Account Bonus, the new account must meet the following requirements 1) Have an ACH Direct Deposit (minimum single deposit of $250), 2) Opt in to eStatements, and 3) Conduct 10 debit and/or credit card point of sale transactions within the first 60 days of account opening. A bonus is paid on day 61 if all qualifications are met, and membership is in good standing.
steps: Open a new Smart Spending Checking account at Premier America Credit Union (13+; $0 monthly service fee, $0 overdraft fees).
Within the first 60 days: (a) have at least one ACH direct deposit of $250+ post, (b) opt in to eStatements, and (c) conduct 10+ debit and/or credit card point-of-sale transactions.
Keep membership in good standing through day 61.
Receive the $100 bonus paid on day 61.
catches: All three requirements (single $250+ ACH DD, eStatements, 10 card POS transactions) must be completed within the first 60 days.
Members with existing or converted checking accounts are not eligible; individuals whose prior membership closed within the past 24 months are also excluded.
The bonus is subject to IRS tax reporting (1099 form).
Offer subject to change or end without notice; cannot be combined with other offers.
Available to individuals 13+ (13-17 require a parent/sponsoring adult as joint owner).
biggest_catch: All three requirements (a single $250+ ACH direct deposit, eStatements enrollment, and 10 card point-of-sale transactions) must be completed within the first 60 days - and anyone with an existing or recently closed (24 months) Premier America checking account is excluded.
eligibility: New Smart Spending Checking members with no existing or converted checking account; no prior Premier America membership closed within 24 months. 13+ (joint owner required under 18).
timing: Bonus paid on day 61 if all qualifications are met. No stated expiry; offer subject to end without notice.
